architecture_required.qualification: Full-service witness; same declared stock and mixed continuous/discrete domain, two independently seeded 100M searches plus a 100k readout branch search; independent finer-integration repeat. Numerical factory qualification, not a symbolic global impossibility theorem.

structure.area_note: Original reference area408mm2 is retained. New public fixed-width stocks use actual L*b and the same 300mm2 limit in every branch.
structure.chi_note: Reference stress/40MPa and energy duty burden are reported separately; they are not one interchangeable chi.

claim: Original full transient factory calibration only; no Agent performance measured. Numerical branch exclusion is not a symbolic global impossibility proof.
